reached the stream until it CLOSED — a long-lived stream, a socket say,
compressed everything and sent none of it. php makes `fflush()` a flush point for
the filter and pushes a `Z_SYNC_FLUSH` pass, which closes the current block and
emits the `00 00 ff ff` marker. Measured on `php -n` 8.5.6 over 400 bytes to a
